summary: Completed backend regression and desktop/mobile UI testing for PSC branding, movements, quick masters, dealer directory/profile, and responsive layout.

critical.issue: Accepts an empty items array with HTTP 200 and posts a zero-quantity, zero-value movement.

integration_issues.issue: Supplier, dealer, and warehouse quick-add controls work and auto-select, but there is no brand quick-add control in either movement form despite the requirement.

action_items: Reject TransactionIn.items when empty before creating a ledger record (HTTP 400 with a meaningful detail).
Add brand quick-add within movement forms, or provide a clearly connected model/brand creation path that remains in the form and auto-selects the new brand/model.
critical_code_review_comments: TransactionIn declares items as list[ItemIn] but has no min-length validation; create_transaction then computes and persists zero totals.
Transaction IDs based on count_documents()+1 remain vulnerable to collisions under concurrent posts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows; brand quick-add requirement incomplete

seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed dealer, one TEST-prefixed multi-item outward transaction, and TEST-prefixed inward regression transactions; UI also created UI2 Supplier, UI2 Warehouse, and UI2 Dealer records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PSC branding, dashboard KPIs, stock search/filter, ledger navigation, quick supplier/dealer/warehouse adds, multi-line add/remove, dealer profile JSON/UI, and mobile overflow passed. Recheck empty transaction rejection and implement/retest brand quick-add.
rca of the issue: The transaction Pydantic model allows an empty list and create_transaction does not guard against it, so total_quantity and total_value become zero and the document is inserted. The brand quick-add gap is in the UI: TransactionModal exposes party and warehouse add buttons only, while product selection has no brand creation affordance. No APIs were mocked.
